meta.title: Lesson 21: Research Week Review
meta.title_zh: 第 21 课：研究英语周复习

study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: This week I learned to ask a clear data question. I cleaned empty cells and checked dates. I read a chart and looked for evidence. These steps slow me down, but they make the answer safer.
segments.tts: This week I learned to ask a clear data question. I cleaned empty cells and checked dates. I read a chart and looked for evidence. These steps slow me down, but they make the answer safer.
segments.zh: 这周我学会提出清楚的数据问题。我清理空单元格，检查日期，阅读图表并寻找证据。这些步骤会让我慢一点，但能让答案更安全。讲解：cell=单元格，safe=安全的，slow down=放慢。

segments.en: I also practiced explaining a number. I gave the source and the context. I separated fact from opinion. When I do not know, I say I do not know. Honest uncertainty is better than a confident guess.
segments.tts: I also practiced explaining a number. I gave the source and the context. I separated fact from opinion. When I do not know, I say I do not know. Honest uncertainty is better than a confident guess.
segments.zh: 我还练习解释一个数字，说明来源和上下文，区分事实与观点。不知道时，我就说不知道。诚实的不确定性比自信的猜测更好。讲解：uncertainty=不确定性，confident=自信的，guess=猜测。

segments.en: Next week I will use English with AI tools. I will write a clear prompt, check the answer, and keep a record of the source. The goal is not to sound clever. The goal is to think clearly.
segments.tts: Next week I will use English with AI tools. I will write a clear prompt, check the answer, and keep a record of the source. The goal is not to sound clever. The goal is to think clearly.
segments.zh: 下周我会用英语配合 AI 工具。我会写清楚的提示词，检查答案，并记录来源。目标不是听起来聪明，而是清楚地思考。讲解：tool=工具，prompt=提示词，source=来源，sound clever=听起来聪明。

chunks.eg: Look for evidence in the data.
Uncertainty is better than a confident guess.
The goal is to think clearly.

patterns.cn: 这些步骤让 X 更安全。

patterns.t: When I do not know, I X.
The goal is not X. The goal is Y.
patterns.cn: 目标不是 X，目标是 Y。

transfer_tasks.task: Write a weekly review. Use ask a clear question, better than a confident guess, and think clearly.
